question: What core academic disciplines combine to form nursing informatics?

options.B: Nursing science, computer science, and information science
options.C: Public health, epidemiology, and software engineering
options.D: Biostatistics, clinical psychology, and hardware design

explanation: Nursing informatics integrates nursing science with computer and information sciences to manage and communicate health data effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: Why is basic digital literacy considered essential for modern clinical practice?

options.A: It replaces the requirement for direct patient physical assessments
options.B: It eliminates the need for any written nursing care plans
options.C: It streamlines workflows and supports accurate documentation
options.D: It guarantees complete immunity from hospital cybersecurity breaches

explanation: Proficiency with software applications enables nurses to manage electronic records efficiently, thereby improving communication and reducing clinical errors. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: Which software feature is most useful for standardizing recurring hospital department paperwork?
explanation: Templates provide a standardized layout that saves time and ensures consistency when creating repeated documents like handover sheets or care protocols. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: What is the primary benefit of incorporating tables and bulleted lists into clinical care guidelines?

options.A: They drastically reduce the file storage size on local computer drives
options.B: They automatically convert plain text into encrypted secure transmissions
options.C: They eliminate the need for supervisory review before publication
options.D: They make complex information easier for staff to read and follow quickly

explanation: Structuring information with tables and bullets breaks up dense text blocks, allowing busy clinicians to scan and comprehend protocols efficiently. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: What is the fundamental structural unit of a standard spreadsheet application?

options.A: Sequential text blocks bound by margin parameters
options.B: Hierarchical database tables connected by relationships
options.C: Rows and columns intersecting into individual cells
options.D: Interactive slides linked via multimedia hyperlinks

explanation: Spreadsheets are organized as a grid of rows and columns, where each intersection creates an individual cell for data entry. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: A ward manager wants to calculate the total monthly consumption of intravenous cannulas across four sub-units. Which tool is most appropriate for this task?

options.A: A spreadsheet utilizing basic addition formulas
options.B: A secure messaging platform with broadcast features
options.C: A word processing document with bullet points
options.D: A presentation slide featuring animated graphics

explanation: Spreadsheets excel at numerical organization and automated calculation, making them the ideal choice for tracking and summing inventory metrics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of utilizing the 'Presenter View' feature during a lecture?

options.A: It encrypts the presentation file against unauthorized external copying
options.B: It converts static slide text into an interactive spreadsheet grid
options.C: It allows the speaker to view notes while the audience sees the slide
options.D: It automatically translates spoken words into live foreign subtitles

explanation: Presenter view displays the current slide, upcoming animations, and speaker notes on one screen, while projecting only the clean slide to the audience. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: Which design practice is most effective when creating educational slides for community health outreach?

options.A: Employing rapid slide transitions and flashing text effects constantly
options.B: Filling every blank space with dense paragraphs of medical definitions
options.C: Using minimal text, clear typography, and relevant visual graphics
options.D: Relying entirely on complex financial charts and statistical tables

explanation: Clean design with limited text and strong visuals prevents cognitive overload and helps audiences retain public health messaging. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: What is the primary reason a nurse must log off a clinical computer workstation immediately after completing documentation?

options.A: To clear the computer random access memory and speed up processing
options.B: To automatically print a physical backup copy of the nursing notes
options.C: To update the operating system software to the latest secure version
options.D: To prevent unauthorized individuals from viewing sensitive patient data

explanation: Leaving a terminal logged in creates a privacy breach vulnerability, allowing anyone nearby to view or alter confidential health records. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)

question: Which of the following practices represents a direct violation of digital health data security principles?

options.A: Reporting an unfamiliar system error message immediately to IT support
options.B: Sharing a personal user login password with a trusted colleague during a busy shift
options.C: Accessing only the specific patient records required for direct clinical care
options.D: Locking mobile computer carts when stepping away to answer a call bell

explanation: Login credentials are tied to individual accountability; sharing passwords compromises system integrity and violates strict patient privacy protocols. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)
